meta.title: Events Certificates: a WordPress Meetup
meta.description: Try Events Certificates: a demo meetup with three made-up participants is ready in the Generator; issue and download their certificates, or open the Quick generator to type your own.
meta.author: camaleaun

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
wp_set_current_user( 1 );
if ( ! \EventsCertificate\Events\all() ) {
	$id = \EventsCertificate\Events\save(
		array(
			'title'     => 'WordPress Meetup: Blocks in practice',
			'start'     => gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '-1 day' ) ) . ' 19:00',
			'end'       => gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '-1 day' ) ) . ' 21:00',
			'community' => 'WordPress Example Group',
			'venue'     => 'Example Hall',
			'city'      => 'Example City',
		)
	);
	foreach ( array( 'Ana Example', 'Bruno Example', 'Carla Example' ) as $name ) {
		\EventsCertificate\People\add( $id, array( 'name' => $name, 'status' => 'attended', 'source' => 'manual' ) );
	}
}
